translations.web: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
translations.bsb: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will hunger. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
translations.kjv: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
translations.asv: Woe unto you, ye that are full now! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you, ye that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
